name: Flat watermelon
summary: Flat watermelon: a red wedge slice with black seeds and rind, or a striped whole melon, for summer food.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the item rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~350 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: variant
params.note: slice = wedge with seeds and rind, whole = striped oval melon

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, pop = scale in
